verdict.rationale: Fern ships official MCP servers. It auto-generates and hosts one for every docs site with Ask Fern enabled, which connects clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It also hosts a private organization MCP server that you register with your coding agent to look up config syntax and read sites, deployments, and reader activity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully, and the per-site server depends on Ask Fern being enabled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Fern automatically generates and hosts a production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled.
The server connects AI clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf to your documentation as an external data source
Fern hosts a private Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for your organization, with full context on Fern’s documentation and configuration
Register it with your coding agent to look up `docs.yml` syntax, components, and CLI commands while you build
